Name: Fist Puncher
Overview:
Fist Puncher follows a team of vigilantes led by Dr. Karate, world renowned neurosurgeon and black belt, as they perform unnecessary surgery on the crime lords that hold a lawless city in their brutal grip.

The gameplay is true to the classic era of button mashing brawlers, as players choose from a colorful cast of characters and take to the streets to battle relentless waves of thugs and ruffians. Fist Puncher combines the glory days of multi-player beat 'em ups with modern gameplay elements like unlockables, easter eggs, achievements, and RPG elements.

Tase tweakers on a nude beach, crash a nazi birthday party, attack villains with swarms of killer bees, convert enemies to boyfriends with a flirtatious kiss attack, battle suicide bombers, power up your beard, punch out protesters, or just run around and collect as many hotdogs and cupcakes as you can carry - it's Fist Puncher so expect the unexpected.
